white-canvas.$description: White Canvas — Page background, product photography backdrop, hero base layer

mist.$description: Mist — Primary light surface for cards, product tiles, section bands, input fills, hairline borders — the most-used non-white color

soft-mist.$description: Soft Mist — Elevated surface layer one step above Mist for nested cards or secondary content blocks

pale-slate.$description: Pale Slate — Button and navigation borders, subtle dividers, outlined-control stroke

steel.$description: Steel — Secondary text, muted helper labels, subdued body copy where Deep Slate would feel too heavy

deep-slate.$description: Deep Slate — The signature brand color — primary text, all hairline borders (536 nav + 304 misc border uses), nav link color, footer text, and the single dark surface tone that anchors the otherwise pale system

deep-ink.$description: Deep Ink — Heaviest heading text where maximum contrast against white is needed

carbon.$description: Carbon — Icon strokes, strict-contrast text, and occasional fill — used sparingly only when absolute black is required

libre-caslon-condensed.$description: Editorial display — the wordmark, section headings, and any text that needs to feel like a magazine title. Used at only three sizes, all dramatic, all in a single weight 400. The condensed proportions and negative tracking make the brand name feel architectural and permanent rather than decorative.

circular-pro.$description: The single workhorse sans for all navigation, body copy, buttons, links, inputs, icons, and utility UI. The geometric neutrality and slightly wide letterforms give the system a calm, clinical tone appropriate to a biology-driven skincare brand. Never goes above 16px, never goes bold — the 400 weight at small sizes is the only voice UI text gets.
